disposition.change: Seed one open task and one active timer per active case; set remaining timer offsets as timer table rows at load review; no criterion change if counts differ.
disposition.note: Tasks and timers are not seeded by the deviation slice; the case estate owns them.

disposition.change: Distribute 2,812 cases by product group to queue rows of the seed file; cap every member at 40 open cases; tune via seed-file rows.
disposition.note: Queue and member distribution belongs to the case estate, not the deviation slice.

disposition.change: Confirm at decision-record contract review the decision code for seeded raises and for seeded exclusions; the seed and criteria stay unchanged if codes differ.
disposition.note: Decision code is fixed by the decision-record contract, not by this story text.
